integrity: The infinite-parameter proof is written out; finite exhaustive and symbolic-population checks supplement rather than certify it. No independent audit has been performed. Historical equivalence cannot be ruled out beyond the inspected primary texts and search results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns synchronous binary strict-neighbor-majority updates with tie retention on full joins of a clique and an independent set. The asymptotic requires b tending to infinity with a>b and even total order; no extension to arbitrary split graphs or alternative update conventions is implied.
title: A sharp three-round majority-relaxation phase on complete split graphs
